links.outcome: Sensitivity of LLM MCQ accuracy to option-order changes
links.effect: Option-order testing showed absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive; full option-order counterbalancing remains future work.
links.quote: Post-generation audits showed that refreshed construction reduced measurable answer cues, while option-order testing showed that absolute MCQ scores remain position-sensitive.

links.outcome: LLM accuracy range on MS-MRI knowledge benchmark across 12 endpoints
links.effect: Accuracy spanned 42.8 percentage points (89.7% to 46.9%); 25.5% of items were missed by at least four endpoints.
links.quote: Evaluation across 12 primary LLM endpoints yielded 36,696 item-level predictions and separated performance over a 42.8-percentage-point accuracy range (89.7% to 46.9%).

unlisted_practices: Automated source-grounded benchmark construction with automated quality audits and answer-cue auditing for subspecialty LLM evaluation

screen.reason: The paper presents MS-Exam-Gen, an automated benchmark framework to test LLM knowledge on multiple sclerosis MRI, and evaluates 12 LLMs on this benchmark without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
